answer: Because the anchor decay curve is applied at close, the delta weight of every idle key falls, and the ridge history recomputes it from replay. A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny as a result loses 84 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. Attestation weight decays 77% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. That is 30 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
